title: DANA CORPORATION: DANA SPICER/TRAILER AXLE ASSEMBLIES (56 affected)
summary: DANA SPICER TRAILER AXLES FOR USE ON GREAT DANE TRAILERS EQUIPPED WITH WHEEL HUBS AND WHEEL BEARINGS.  THESE AXLES UTILIZED DANA'S LMS (LOW MAINTENANCE SYSTEM) WHEEL HUB ARRANGEMENT, IN WHICH A SOLID SPACER IS USED BETWEEN THE INNER AND OUTER WHEEL BEARING CONE TO ESTABLISH WHEEL BEARING ENDPLAY.  DANA HAS DETERMINED THAT SOME OF THESE TRAILER AXLES MAY HAVE BEEN EQUIPPED WITH THE INCORRECT OUTER WHEEL BEARING CONE.

title: BMW of North America, LLC: BMW/SEAT BELT BUCKLE TENSIONER (2,635 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN PASSENGER VEHICLES, THE CONNECTION OF THE SAFETY BELT BUCKLE TO THE STEEL ROPE OF THE TENSIONER DOES NOT MEET BMW SPECIFICATIONS.  IN SEVERE FRONTAL CRASHES, THIS CONNECTION CAN DETACH.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): DAIMLERCHRYSLER/IDLE SPEED (19,500 affected)
summary: CERTAIN PICKUP TRUCKS, EQUIPPED WITH CUMMINS DIESEL ENGINES AND MANUAL TRANSMISSIONS, MAY EXPERIENCE AN ELEVATED IDLE SPEED AFTER EXTENDED CRUISE CONTROL USE.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): DAIMLERCHRYSLER/LOWER CONTROL ARM BALL JOINTS (11,698 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN PASSENGER VEHICLES, THE LOWER CONTROL ARM BALL JOINTS MAY EXPERIENCE A LOSS OF LUBRICATION THAT CAN RESULT IN ACCELERATED WEAR AND POSSIBLE SEPARATION FROM THE STEERING KNUCKLE.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): DAIMLERCHRYSLER/SEAT BACK RECLINING BOLT (1,066,000 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN PASSENGER VEHICLES, SEAT BACK RECLINER BOLT BREAKAGE CAN OCCUR RESULTING IN THE SEAT BACK RECLINING UNEXPECTEDLY.

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/FMVSS 214/REAR DOOR UPPER HINGE WELDS (107 affected)
summary: CERTAIN SPORT UTILITY VEHICLES FAIL TO COMPLY WITH REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 214, "SIDE IMPACT PROTECTION."  THESE VEHICLES ARE BUILT WITH FOUR WELDS ON THE REAR DOOR UPPER HINGE.  ON SOME OF THESE VEHICLES, ONE OR TWO OF THE WELDS MAY NOT BE TO SPECIFICATION.

title: Volvo Trucks North America: VOLVO TRUCKS/SLEEPER SECTION WINDOW GLASS (2,435 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN HEAVY DUTY CLASS 8 TRUCKS,  THE SLEEPER SECTION UPPER SIDE WINDOW GLASS MAY DE-BOND FROM THE WINDOW OPENING SLIDE TRACK MECHANISM.

title: Autocar, LLC: AUTOCAR/ DRIVE AXLE SEAT (32 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN HEAVY DUTY CLASS 8 TRUCKS WITH VOLVO B-RIDE REAR SUSPENSION, THE FORWARD AND/OR REAR DRIVE AXLE UPPER AXLE UPPER SEAT COULD BREAK ALLOWING THE AFFECTED AXLE TO SHIFT OUT OF ALIGNMENT.

title: U.S. BUS CORPORATION: U.S. BUS/WARNING LAMPS (3 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN SCHOOL BUS WARNING LAMPS. A STATIC ELECTRICITY DISCHARGE CAN OCCUR DURING NORMAL SERVICES OR HANDLING.  THIS DISCHARGE CAN POTENTIALLY INITIATE A CHEMICAL REACTION OF MATERIALS WITHIN THE LAMP WHICH COULD CAUSE THE LENS TO FRACTURE.

title: Indian Motorcycle Company: INDIAN MOTORCYCLE/VOLTAGE REGULATOR (7,947 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN MOTORCYCLES EQUIPPED WITH COMPUFIRE BRAND SERIES TYPE VOLTAGE REGULATORS, IF DAMAGED, THE VOLTAGE REGULATOR CAN BECOME STUCK IN AN OPEN MODE THAT ALLOWS BATTERY VOLTAGE TO FLOW BACK THROUGH THE REGULATOR.

title: Coachmen RV Company, LLC: COACHMEN/BRAKE SYSTEM WARNING INDICATOR (3,539 affected)
summary: CERTAIN MOTOR HOME CHASSIS FAIL TO COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 105, "HYDRAULIC AND ELECTRIC BRAKE SYSTEMS."  THE BRAKE SYSTEM WARNING INDICATOR MAY NOT FUNCTION AS REQUIRED BY STANDARD.

title: AFX North America, Inc.: AFX/FMVSS 218/MOTORCYCLE HELMETS WITH WEAK SPOTS (30,478 affected)
summary: MODEL FX-3 MOTORCYCLE HELMETS MANUFACTURED PRIOR TO APRIL 2002.  THE MOLDING PROCESS UNIQUE TO THIS MODEL REQUIRES INJECTION OF THE LINER INTO THE SHELL WHICH LEFT WEAK SPOTS IN THE FRONT OF THE HELMET.  THIS DOES NOT COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 218, "MOTORCYCLE HELMETS."

title: AFX North America, Inc.: AFX/FMVSS 218/MOTORCYCLE HELMETS/CHIN STRAP (30,478 affected)
summary: MODEL FX-3 MOTORCYCLE HELMETS MANUFACTURED PRIOR TO APRIL 2002.  THE CHIN STRAP WAS SEWN WITH ONE BAR TACK AS APPOSED TO TWO BAR TACKS.  THIS DOES NOT COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 218, "MOTORCYCLE HELMETS."

title: HARRISON HYDRA-GEN, INC.: HARRISON HYDRA-GEN/HYDRAULIC PUMPS (62 affected)
summary: HARRISON HYDRA-GEN GENERATOR PUMPS FOR USE ON FIRE TRUCKS. THE TUBING CONNECTING THE SOFT START TO THE GENERATOR PUMP CAN BREAK AWAY FROM THE FITTING AND SPRAY HYDRAULIC FLUID ONTO THE EXHAUST.

title: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing: TOYOTA/CERTIFICATION/GVWR (5,878 affected)
summary: CERTAIN SPORT UTILITY VEHICLES FAIL TO COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF PART 567, "CERTIFICATION."  THE INCORRECT GROSS VEHICLE WEIGHT RATING (GVWR) DATA WAS PRINTED ON THE CERTIFICATION REGULATION LABEL.  THE GVWR IS INCORRECTLY REFLECTED ON THE LABEL AS 6,100 LBS.  THE CORRECT GVWR SHOULD BE 6,000 LBS.

title: Cummins, Inc.: CUMMINS/ALTERNATOR SUPPORT BRACKETS (7,618 affected)
summary: CUMMINS ISB 6 CYLINDER ENGINES BUILT FROM MARCH 1998 THROUGH FEBRUARY 1999, AND HAVE AN ENGINE SERIAL NUMBER WITHIN THE RANGE OF 45480143 TO 45818756 OR 56436052 TO 56561539.  THE LOWER ALTERNATOR SUPPORT BRACE OR MOUNTING HARDWARE CAN LOOSEN OR BREAK WHICH WILL ALLOW THE ALTERNATOR TO DROP ONTO THE ENGINE.

title: Cummins, Inc.: CUMMINS/CRANKSHAFT VIBRATION DAMPER (125 affected)
summary: THE ISB 4 CYLINDER CRANKSHAFT VIBRATION DAMPERS INSTALLED FOR USE ON CHASSIS MANUFACTURED BY WORKHORSE AND FREIGHTLINER CUSTOM CHASSIS.  THE AFFECTED ENGINES WERE BUILT FROM OCTOBER 2000 THROUGH JULY 2001, AND HAVE AN ENGINE SERIAL NUMBER WITHIN THE RANGE OF 21436401 TO 21478129.  THE CRANKSHAFT VIBRATION DAMPERS WERE DESIGNED INCORRECTLY AND CAN LEAD TO CRACKS DEVELOPING IN THE HUB, CAUSING THE PART TO BECOME LOOSE AND POSSIBLY DETACH ITSELF FROM THE ENGINE.

title: Pierce Manufacturing: PIERCE/HARRISON HYDRA-GEN GENERATOR PUMPS (13 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN FIRE CHASSIS EQUIPPED WITH HARRISON HYDRA-GEN GENERATORS. THE TUBING CONNECTING THE SOFT START TO THE GENERATOR PUMP CAN BREAK AWAY FROM THE FITTING AND SPRAY HYDRAULIC FLUID ONTO THE EXHAUST.

title: Blue Bird Body Company: BLUE BIRD/BRAKE HOSE ROUTING (8 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN MOTOR HOMES, THE BRAKE HOSES MAY NOT HAVE BEEN ROUTED PROPERLY RESULTING IN THE HOSES CONTACTING THE FRAME.

title: GEORGIE BOY MFG., LLC: GEORGIE BOY/BRAKE SYSTEM WARNING INDICATOR (2,736 affected)
summary: CERTAIN MOTOR HOME CHASSIS FAIL TO COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 105, "HYDRAULIC AND ELECTRIC BRAKE SYSTEMS."  THE BRAKE SYSTEM WARNING INDICATOR MAY NOT FUNCTION AS REQUIRED BY THE STANDARD.

title: PACCAR Incorporated: PACCAR/KENWORTH/TRAILER LIGHTS (9,890 affected)
summary: CERTAIN TRUCKS EQUIPPED WITH TRAILER CONNECTIONS  FAIL TO COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARDS (FMVSS) NO. 121, "AIR BRAKE SYSTEMS," AND NO. 108, "LAMPS, REFLECTIVE DEVICES, AND ASSOCIATED EQUIPMENT."  THE SUPPLIER REMOVED A RUBBER GROMMET FROM THE TRAILER LIGHT LINE CONNECTOR. THE VEHICLES ARE EXPERIENCING CORROSION AT THE 7-WAY TRAILER CONNECTION.  THIS CAUSES INTERMITTENT FLASHING/FLICKERING OF THE TRAILER LIGHTS.

title: Charles Machine Works, Inc.: CHARLES MACHINE/TRAILER BRAKES (18 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN TRAILERS EQUIPPED WITH HYDRAULIC BRAKES, THE BREAKAWAY BRAKES DO NOT WORK.

title: Mazda North American Operations: MAZDA/FRONT FOG LIGHTS (5,400 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN MINI VANS EQUIPPED WITH FRONT FOG LIGHTS,THE FOG LIGHT BULB SOCKET MAY HAVE BEEN INSTALLED IMPROPERLY.

title: DAYTON WIRE WHEEL, INC.: AMERICAN WIRE WHEEL/REPLACEMENT WHEELS (32 affected)
summary: AFTERMARKET REPLACEMENT AMERICAN WIRE WHEELS, MODELS SUPERSPOKEII (P/N M0163540S-184) AND SUPERSPOKE (P/N M12121540S-200 & M32121540S-200).  THE STEEL SPOKES CAN PULL OUT OF THE MACHINED ALUMINUM HUB WHICH WILL RESULT IN COMPLETE FAILURE OF THE WHEEL.

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/SEAT BELT BUCKLE/LATCH (18,327 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN VANS WITH A GROSS VEHICLE WEIGHT OF LESS THAN 8,500 POUNDS, DURING A VEHICLE CRASH SUFFICIENT ENOUGH TO DEPLOY THE SAFETY BELT PRETENSIONER, THE FRONT SAFETY BELT BUCKLES MAY NOT RELEASE AFTER THE VEHICLE CRASH, OR ALTERNATELY MAY EJECT THE SAFETY BELT LATCH DURING THE VEHICLE CRASH.

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/DRIVER'S AIR BAG (130 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN MINI VANS, PASSENGER AND SPORT UTILITY VEHICLES, SOME OF THESE VEHICLES HAVE A DRIVER'S SIDE AIR BAG THAT MAY NOT DEPLOY AS DESIGNED.   IN ADDITION, THE AIR BAG INFLATOR COULD RUPTURE.

title: CARLISLE TIRE AND WHEEL: AFTERMARKET WHEELS (2,670 affected)
summary: 17 X 8 CRAGAR S/S CLASSIC WHEELS MANUFACTURED BETWEEN FEBRUARY 16, 2001, AND FEBRUARY 18, 2002.  THE DEFECT IS A WELD THAT DID NOT FULLY PENETRATE TO THE BASE METAL.  THE WHEEL WOULD DEVELOP CRACKS ALONG THE WELD AND COULD FAIL TO HOLD THE LOAD AS IT WAS DESIGNED TO ACCOMMODATE.

title: VECTOR PRODUCTS, INC.: VECTOR/AFTERMARKET COFFEE MAKER (12,000 affected)
summary: AFTERMARKET VECTOR COFFEE MAKERS PACKAGED AS GREATLAND, MODEL NO. VEC216GT, AND VECTOR, MODEL NO. VEC216.  THE HEATING ELEMENT INSIDE THE PRODUCT CAN LOOSEN CAUSING IT TO COME IN CONTACT WITH THE PLASTIC BOTTOM LAYER WHICH SUBSEQUENTLY HEATS THE SURFACE IT SETS ON.

title: Subaru of America, Inc.: SUBARU/SEAT BELT BUCKLE/LATCH ASSEMBLIES (326 affected)
summary: CERTAIN PASSENGER VEHICLES FAIL TO COMPLY WITH REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 209, "SEAT BELT ASSEMBLIES."  THE LEFT AND RIGHT FRONT SEAT BELT BUCKLE/LATCH ASSEMBLIES WERE IMPROPERLY MANUFACTURED.

title: Winnebago Industries, Inc.: WINNEBAGO/SPARE TIRE MOUNTING PLATE (176 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN MODEL D30B MOTOR HOMES BUILT ON A FORD CHASSIS, A PLATE, WHICH IS USED TO SUPPORT THE SPARE TIRE, WAS INADVERTENTLY LEFT OFF A NUMBER OF THESE MOTOR HOMES.

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/STEERING COLUMN INTERMEDIATE SHAFT (4,512 affected)
summary: IN SOME OF THESE SPORT UTILITY VEHICLES, THE DIAMETER OF THE STEERING COLUMN INTERMEDIATE SHAFT IS TOO SMALL.

title: IC CORPORATION: IC/WARNING LAMPS (46 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN SCHOOL BUS WARNING LAMPS, A STATIC ELECTRICITY DISCHARGE CAN OCCUR DURING NORMAL SERVICES OR HANDLING.  THIS DISCHARGE CAN POTENTIALLY INITIATE A CHEMICAL REACTION OF MATERIALS WITHIN THE LAMP WHICH COULD CAUSE THE LENS TO FRACTURE.

title: Triple E Recreational Vehicles: TRIPLE E/BRAKE SYSTEM WARNING INDICATOR (99 affected)
summary: CERTAIN MOTOR HOME CHASSIS FAIL TO COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 105, "HYDRAULIC AND ELECTRIC BRAKE SYSTEMS."  THE BRAKE SYSTEM WARNING INDICATOR MAY NOT FUNCTION AS REQUIRED BY STANDARD.

title: Winnebago Industries, Inc.: WINNEBAGO/BRAKE SYSTEM WARNING INDICATOR (8,532 affected)
summary: CERTAIN MOTOR HOME CHASSIS FAIL TO COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 105,"HYDRAULIC AND ELECTRIC BRAKE SYSTEMS."  THE BRAKE SYSTEM WARNING INDICATOR MAY NOT FUNCTION AS REQUIRED BY THE STANDARD.

title: Gillig, LLC: GILLIG/AIR CONDITIONER MOUNTING BOLT (644 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN 1998-2002 35' AND 40' BUSES AND 1999-2002 29' BUSES, THE INSTALLATION OF THE AIR CONDITIONER UNIT USES BOLTS ALONG THE EDGE OF THE HOUSING FOR ATTACHMENT.  ONE SPECIFIC BOLT CAN BE TOO CLOSE TO THE MAIN POWER CABLE ATTACHMENT.  POSITIONAL TOLERANCE OR THE USE OF TOO LONG A BOLT COULD CAUSE AN ELECTRICAL SHORT.

title: NATIONAL RV, INC.: NATIONAL RV/BRAKE SYSTEM WARNING INDICATOR (2,761 affected)
summary: CERTAIN MOTOR HOME CHASSIS FAIL TO COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 105, "HYDRAULIC AND ELECTRIC BRAKE SYSTEMS."  THE BRAKE SYSTEM WARNING INDICATOR MAY NOT FUNCTION AS REQUIRED BY STANDARD.

title: Jayco, Inc.: JAYCO/FUEL RETURN LINE (4 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN RECREATIONAL VEHICLES BUILT ON GM GMT610 RV CHASSIS, DUE TO A CHANGE IN THE FUEL SYSTEM OF THESE CHASSIS, INCREASED PRESSURE RESULTS IN THE FUEL RETURN LINE.  THE FUEL RETURN LINE IS USED TO PROVIDE A FUEL TAP FOR GENERATORS AND AUXILIARY ENGINES.

title: Harley-Davidson Motor Company: HARLEY DAVIDSON/MIRROR (11,952 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN MOTORCYCLES, THE MIRROR STEM COULD FRACTURE ALLOWING THE MIRROR TO FALL.

title: Daimler Commercial Buses NA: ORION/ENGINE COOLING FAN MOTOR HOSE (416 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN TRANSIT BUSES EQUIPPED WITH DETROIT DIESEL SERIES 50 ENGINE CONFIGURATIONS, A HYDRAULIC MOTOR USED TO DRIVE THE ENGINE COOLING FAN MOTOR HAS TWO HOSES CONNECTED TO IT, INCLUDING A HIGH PRESSURE INPUT HOSE.  THE HIGH PRESSURE HOSE IS CONSTRUCTED WITH REUSABLE OR CRIMP ENDS.  THE HYDRAULIC MOTOR IS LOCATED AT THE REAR OF THE BUS, INSIDE THE ENGINE COMPARTMENT.  THE END OF THE HOSE THAT IS CONNECTED TO THE FAN MOTOR HAS DISCONNECTED FROM THE HOSE CONNECTOR.

title: INTERNATIONAL TRUCK & ENGINE CORPORATION: INTERNATIONAL/BOSCH ZOPS DISC BRAKES (35,074 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN SCHOOL AND TRANSIT BUSES BUILT WITH BOSCH ZERO OFFSET PIN SLIDE (ZOPS) HYDRAULIC DISC BRAKES, THE ZOPS HYDRAULIC DISC BRAKES MAY EXPERIENCE CALIPERS STICKING IN THE APPLIED POSITION, WHICH CAN RESULT IN EXCESSIVE OR ABNORMAL HEAT GENERATION AT ONE OR MORE OF THE BRAKES.

title: Nissan North America, Inc.: NISSAN/AIR BAG MODULE (64,562 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN VEHICLES, THE ELECTRICAL CONNECTOR FOR THE DRIVER AIR BAG MAY COME LOOSE.  IF THE CONNECTOR COMES LOOSE, THE SUPPLEMENTAL AIR BAG WARNING LIGHT FLASHES INTERMITTENTLY.

title: AMERICAN PRODUCTS COMPANY: APC/REPLACEMENT LAMP LENSES & HEADLAMP BULBS (539,000 affected)
summary: APC REPLACEMENT LAMP LENSES AND REPLACEMENT HEADLAMP BULBS.  THE LENSES AND BULBS DO NOT COMPLY WITH FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 108, "LAMPS, REFLECTIVE DEVICES, AND ASSOCIATED EQUIPMENT."  THE UNITS DO NOT CONTAIN THE COMPREHENSIVE SET OF LAMPS AND REFLECTIVE DEVICES.

title: Historical tsunami: waves up to 1 m, Philippines (2003-02-15)
summary: A tsunami on 2003-02-15 after an M6.3 earthquake, from NOAA NCEI's global historical tsunami database.

title: CPSC, Kawasaki Motors Corp. U.S.A. Announce Recall of ATVs
summary: There is the potential for failure of a weld securing the tie-rod plate to the steering column. If the weld fails, the plate can become detached from the steering column, resulting in a loss of steering control. Units: 732.

title: CPSC, Eton America Announce Recall of Youth All-Terrain Vehicles (ATVs)
summary: The ATV contains a remote shutoff switch that shuts the ATV off. For the remote shutoff switch to work, the receiver switch on the ATV must be in the on position. It was possible for the ATV to be started with the receiver switch in the off position. The ATV could not be shutoff with the remote swit

title: CPSC, Thomas & Betts Announce Recall of Emergency Exit Signs
summary: The emergency exit signs have an internal electrical component that could overheat and fail, when connected to 277-volt electrical systems, and melt the enclosure, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 31,000.

title: CPSC, Trak Inc. Announce Recall of Snowshoe Bindings
summary: Screws and other hardware used to keep the bindings intact are too short, causing the binding to separate from the shoe. This poses a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 420.

title: CPSC, UWATEC AG Announce Recall of 1995 Aladin Air X NitrOx Dive Computers
summary: Software in the dive computers may inaccurately calculate desaturation times, resulting in possible decompression sickness under aggressive dive conditions. Units: About 390.

title: CPSC, Fireworks of Alabama Announce Recall of Bamboo-Stick Sparklers
summary: The sparklers' bamboo-stick handles can catch fire, burn and disintegrate and emit burning fragments during use. These sparklers present a fire hazard and a risk of burn injury. Units: About 72,000.

title: CPSC, Playnation Play Systems Announce Recall of "Fun Buckets" on Backyard Play Sets
summary: As children play on the play set's slide or platform, the 6- to 8-ft free- hanging rope can become entangled around the child's neck. This presents a strangulation hazard to young children. Units: About 1,400.

title: CPSC, Robert Bosch Tool Corp. Announce Recall of Skil® Warrior Drill Battery Chargers
summary: The transformer inside the charger can overheat. If this occurs, the charger housing can melt and deform, possibly igniting flammable materials near or on the charger. Units: About 2 million.

title: CPSC, Exmark Recalls Lazer HP Riding Mowers
summary: The engines for these products had fuel lines that were too long and could possibly droop and come in contact with moving parts, which can cut the fuel lines, resulting in fuel leakage. Units: About 1,500.

title: CPSC, Toro Company Recall Z-100 Riding Mowers
summary: The engines for these products had fuel lines that were too long and could possibly droop and come in contact with moving parts, which can cut the fuel lines, resulting in fuel leakage. Units: About 400.

title: CPSC, Young's J.K. Inc. Announce Recall of Novelty Lighters
summary: These lighters do not have child-resistant mechanisms, as required by federal law. Young children can ignite the lighters, presenting fire and burn hazards. Units: About 500.

title: CPSC, Random House, Inc. Announce Recall of Children's Board Book Sets
summary: The book sets were sold in cardboard boxes with plastic snaps. The plastic snaps can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 360,000.

title: CPSC, The Betesh Group Announce Recall of "Busy Bug" Plush Toys
summary: The antennae of the plush toy can be chewed or pulled off, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 11,200.

title: CPSC, The First Years® Inc. Announce New Safety Instructions to Prevent Injuries for Combo Baby Tubs/Step Stools
summary: When used as a tub, babies' body parts can be pinched if the product's footrest is not fully extended, so that it clicks into place firmly. Units: 120,000.

title: CPSC, BRIO Corp. Announce Recall of Toy Trumpet
summary: A small knob on the side of the trumpet can break off, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 4,000.
